blocks.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. 

Excursion to the Argentine waterfalls accompanied by an English-speaking guide. We will take a walk to the National Park and admire the waterfalls from special observation decks located high above them. Multi-ton jets of water form a huge number of waterfalls of various shapes and heights, over which multi-colored rainbows hang. Impressions from this spectacle will remain with you for a lifetime. Particularly impressive is the waterfall called Devil's Throat, which is the largest of the waterfalls.  The national park covers an area of 55,500 hectares, which preserve the diverse and unique flora and fauna of the region.
